answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, split across independent auditors, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. By the ocean of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The whisper holds work receipts rather than names, so the river of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
